lessons.title: Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) Cell & Container Inspection Matrix
lessons.summary: Perform automated incoming batch inspection: OCV variance check, internal resistance sigma screening, and enclosure IP55/IP66 seal verification.
checkpoints: Generate automated pass/fail non-conformance punch list
Sign off mechanical and electrical factory sign-off sheets

lessons.title: Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) Insulation, Hi-Pot & E-Stop Verification
lessons.summary: Verify DC bus galvanic isolation, high-potential dielectric withstand (Hi-Pot 2500V DC), gas detection interlocking, and hardwired E-Stop latency.
checkpoints: Validate tripping of DC contactors under simulated fault
Verify NFPA 855 emergency deflagration vent readiness

lessons.title: Capacity Rating, Round-Trip Efficiency (RTE) & Heat Soak Trial
lessons.summary: Execute continuous C/2 charge-discharge cycle at POI (Point of Interconnection) factoring in HVAC and transformer auxiliary consumption.
inputs: Revenue-grade POI energy meter telemetry (kWh_in, kWh_out)
checkpoints: Quantify auxiliary parasite ratio under high-temperature heat soak

lessons.title: Grid Interconnection Compliance (IEEE 1547 / IEC 62933) Handover Pack
lessons.summary: Compile audit-ready compliance package: reactive power capability curves (PQ chart), low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) logs, and warranty certificate.
checkpoints: Output formal EPC Handover Document bundle
Issue Certificate of Readiness for Commercial Operation (COD)
